L.title: Requested length L
L.description: Continuous centre-spiral arc length before segmentation. The assembled straight chain is slightly shorter because its links follow chords.

d_tip.title: Nominal tip width
d_tip.description: Width between the two continuous spiral boundaries at θ = 0. The finished tip width is calculated after straightening.

phi_deg.title: Included taper φ
phi_deg.description: Full angle between the continuous taper boundaries. Larger φ makes the base wider for the same length and tip width.

Delta_theta_deg.title: Segment angle Δθ
Delta_theta_deg.description: Angular span of a complete link in the curled construction. Larger values give fewer, coarser links. This is not a joint travel limit.

n_cables.title: Number of cables
n_cables.description: Two cables use flat links and hinge joints. Three or more use n-lobe links and ball joints.

terminal_unit_policy.title: Length completion
terminal_unit_policy.description: Exact keeps the requested arc and may cut a partial base; whole units extends the arc to the next full link.

tendon_inward_shift.title: Cable inward offset
tendon_inward_shift.description: Radial inward shift of simulation routing sites. A further per-link taper correction is applied at the distal site; this is not a guaranteed CAD wall clearance.

base_thickness_m.title: Base centre thickness
base_thickness_m.description: Full Y thickness at the base mounting plane. Auto sets it equal to the generated base width. The tip thickness is derived.

thickness_profile.title: Axial thickness law
thickness_profile.description: Linear tapers within links and across joints. Stepped keeps each link at constant thickness for legacy comparison. Geometry scaling is separate from the joint gain law.

flat_section.title: Two-cable section
flat_section.description: Rectangular or a six-sided section with two centre ridges. The hex section is generally not a regular hexagon.

hex_edge_ratio.title: Hex edge / centre thickness
hex_edge_ratio.description: Edge thickness divided by centre thickness at the same axial station. Smaller values make the centre ridges more pronounced.

nlobe_t.title: Polygon fill t
nlobe_t.description: Polygon radius Rₚ = R[1 + t(sec(π/n) − 1)]. At 0, vertices lie on the reference circle; at 1, sides are tangent before draft.

notch_factor.title: Notch ratio
notch_factor.description: Notch radius divided by half the polygon side length. Zero removes the notches. A convex collision hull bridges these concave notches.

show_preview.title: Desktop preview during build
show_preview.description: Show the legacy 2D approval window before generating. The web builder always runs without this window.

robot_pos.title: Root position
robot_pos.description: Position of link_001 in world coordinates. This affects simulation placement, not exported manufacturing CAD.

robot_quat.title: Root quaternion
robot_quat.description: Root orientation as [w,x,y,z]. [0,0,-1,0] points local +Z downward in world coordinates. Must be nonzero.

joint_stiffness_base.title: Spring coefficient K₀
joint_stiffness_base.description: Uncalibrated base coefficient. Kᵢ = K₀ / βⱼ^[3(i−1)], before the protected base override.

joint_damping_base.title: Damping coefficient D₀
joint_damping_base.description: Uncalibrated damping coefficient, with the same exponent as stiffness.

joint_beta.title: Gain decay βⱼ
joint_beta.description: User-chosen gain decay, independent of geometric βg = exp(bΔθ). Above 1 decreases gains toward the tip; 1 gives constant gains.

first_joint_stiffness.title: Protected base stiffness
first_joint_stiffness.description: Override j_001. A large spring approximates a fixed mount; it is not an actual rigid weld.

first_joint_damping.title: Protected base damping
first_joint_damping.description: Override damping at j_001 only. The gain editing tool preserves this joint.

timestep.title: Physics timestep
timestep.description: Integration step. 0.0001 s is the validated starting point for this SpiRob branch; stability remains load-dependent.

tip_site_pos.title: Tip reference site
tip_site_pos.description: Optional position in the final link’s local body frame. Used as a named measurement/reference point.

collision_mode.title: Contact surface
collision_mode.description: Convex: one zero-mass hull per link. Mesh: native mesh hull with preset settings. Capsule: rounded approximation. Compound: legacy stepped rectangular two-cable only.

mesh_layout.title: Mesh files
mesh_layout.description: Shared reuses one complete-link STL and a partial-base STL; individual writes one STL per link.

physics_preset.title: Physics preset
physics_preset.description: Default preserves existing solver/friction settings. Safe selects capsules unless explicitly overridden; fast and high change solver settings. Explicit JSON/CLI overrides take precedence.

cad_profile.title: CAD profile
cad_profile.description: Fabrication adds a finite central flexure and optional drilled channels. Simulation assembles the rigid link surfaces.

cad.title: Export fabrication CAD
cad.description: Generate whole-robot STEP and millimetre STL, plus a CAD validation report.

iges.title: Also export IGES
iges.description: Optional IGES surface export using OpenCascade. Requires CAD export; STEP is the preferred solid interchange.

fuse_cad.title: Fuse simulation CAD
fuse_cad.description: Join simulation solids where possible. Fabrication is already fused. Requires CAD export.

plain.title: Revolved circular section
plain.description: Advanced comparison mode using the revolved surface without the flat/n-lobe cutter. Convex mode is not supported for this mode.

align_geom_frames.title: Compiled geom frame alignment
align_geom_frames.description: Export an additional version-specific .mjb with aligned geom axes. XML itself retains MuJoCo mesh principal frames.

neck_width_mm.title: Elastic core width / diameter
neck_width_mm.description: Finite central ligament: X width for two cables, cylinder diameter for n cables. This is the available elastic-layer dimension; there is no independent inter-link layer-thickness setting.

cable_hole_diameter_mm.title: Cable channel diameter
cable_hole_diameter_mm.description: Diameter of channels swept along the routing path. Zero leaves the CAD undrilled. Does not change simulation tendon radius or mass.

collision_corner_radius_ratio.title: Compound corner radius ratio
collision_corner_radius_ratio.description: Corner radius / half-width for legacy compound colliders only. Has no effect on convex hulls.

collision_margin_m.title: Contact margin override
collision_margin_m.description: Extra distance at which contacts become active. Auto selects zero for convex/compound or the physics preset value.

arena_memory_mib.title: Arena allocation override
arena_memory_mib.description: Native MuJoCo constraint workspace. Auto uses 128 MiB for compound, otherwise the compiler default. Increasing memory does not improve numerical stability.

flat_thickness_ratio.description: Legacy two-cable ratio; mutually exclusive with base_thickness_m.

taper_angle_deg.description: Legacy alias; must agree with phi_deg.
